reader_summary.overview: We wrap our Berkshire Hathaway trilogy with Warren and Charlie entering a new era: the age of the internet. Can they and Berkshire adapt to this brave new world? And, after 9+ hours, we render our final judgments on Berkshire and Warren's career.

key_points.text: Is "Never bet against America" still the right longterm approach?
Or is there another, even bigger Snowball out there that Warren may be missing?
